description: Chat UI with real-time messaging: Create chat list page showing all conversations and chat room page for real-time messaging with performance optimizations (ListView.builder, pagination, caching, Firestore offline persistence). Includes user list to start new chats. This feature depends on FEAT-003 (auth flow must be complete).
steps: Create d:\higo\lib\widgets\chat_room_tile.dart - ListTile showing chat room preview with cached_network_image for avatar, last message, timestamp, unread badge, using const constructor
Create d:\higo\lib\widgets\message_bubble.dart - message bubble widget with sender/receiver styling, timestamp, read status, using const constructor where possible

Create d:\higo\lib\pages\chat\users_list_page.dart - displays all users from Firestore using ListView.builder for performance, allows selecting user to start chat, creates chat room if not exists, includes search functionality

Create d:\higo\lib\pages\chat\chat_list_page.dart - displays all chat rooms using StreamProvider from chat_rooms_provider, ListView.builder for performance, pull-to-refresh, floating action button to navigate to users_list_page, empty state when no chats

Create d:\higo\lib\pages\chat\chat_room_page.dart - displays messages for selected chat room using StreamProvider from messages_provider, ListView.builder with reverse: true for chat layout, pagination (load 20 messages at a time), TextField for composing message, send button, real-time message updates, optimistic UI updates, offline support with Firestore persistence

Update d:\higo\lib\main.dart to initialize Firebase in main(), wrap app with ProviderScope, configure MaterialApp with Arabic locale, RTL support (Directionality widget), Material Design 3 theme (useMaterial3: true, Arabic font if needed), and set home to auth_wrapper
Enable Firestore offline persistence by configuring FirebaseFirestore.instance.settings in firebase_service.dart with persistenceEnabled: true and cacheSizeBytes: Settings.CACHE_SIZE_UNLIMITED
acceptance_criteria: Chat list page shows all conversations in real-time with last message preview
Users can start new chat by selecting from users list
Chat room page displays messages with pagination (20 at a time)
Messages appear in real-time without manual refresh
Offline mode works - messages are cached and sync when online
ListView.builder is used for performance with large lists
cached_network_image is used for all user avatars
All text is in Arabic and layout is RTL
App builds and runs successfully on Android emulator
findings: All chat UI components implemented successfully. Firebase initialization added to main.dart with Arabic locale and RTL support. Firestore offline persistence enabled. Message pagination implemented with 20 messages per page. Build completed with Kotlin daemon warnings (non-critical). flutter analyze passes with no issues.
